author: Arvin Ash
description:
"What happens if you keep cutting paper forever?" https://youtu.be/ux-AWup9aVI
Arvin goes through the process of cutting paper, what bonds are broken, what are not. You may be shocked to see that molecular bonds DO get broken, but there is a hard stop that scissors cannot get past. This video gets into nuclear scattering and nuclear fission. 
Ever wondered about the ultimate limit of cutting? This video explores what it means to go beyond ordinary tools and delves into the science of splitting an atom. We discuss the immense energy required and how methods like particle accelerator technology are essential for manipulating atoms at such a fundamental level. Join us to understand the intriguing world of nuclear physics and the process of fission.
title: How To "cut" an atom with Scissors! #physics #mindblown
